description: Documentaries about real criminal cases. Evidence discipline is absolute: nothing about a case is invented, and victims are treated with care.
entity_handling: Never invent evidence, dates, locations, relationships or crime-scene details — if the script and retrieved sources do not state it, it does not appear.
Victims are named as the script names them and never reduced to evidence; graphic detail is never emphasised beyond what the narration itself states.
A suspect is described as charged or arrested until the script states a conviction or guilty plea; legal status is never upgraded by implication.
Case facts from a single retrieved source stay labelled with that source; uncorroborated claims are not presented as settled.
label: True crime
music_mood: Tense minimal piano and strings (metadata only — no music library is integrated; the soundtrack remains user-supplied or absent).

pacing.notes: Informational only — narration is not retimed to pacing targets.
